headline: Wii Sports: 82 million copies
title: Wii Sports Facts | Nintendo Best Seller | Classic Games
video_script: Wii Sports came free with the Nintendo Wii console when it launched in November twenty oh six. It has five sports: tennis, baseball, bowling, golf and boxing, all played by swinging the Wii Remote. It sold eighty two million copies, making it the best selling Nintendo game ever and the best selling game exclusive to one console. Your player was your own Mii. Which sport was your best? Comment below!
description: Wii Sports (Nintendo, 2006) came bundled with the Wii, has five sports and sold 82 million copies, Nintendo's best selling game. Source: Wikipedia.
